title: Icyifuzo mu cyumba gitagatifu
intro: Ukinjira mu rusengero rutuje, ukabona umugaragu w’Imana wiyeguriye Imana ahagaze asenga. Amaboko yabo arazamuwe, amaso yabo arazamuwe, kandi imitima yabo ifite icyifuzo cy’ubuzima bwabo bwose. Ni nde uyu muntu wihangana ufite icyizere muri Allah kitigeze gihungabana?
clues: Namaze imyaka myinshi mu gusenga no mu kuramya, nibonera ibitangaza byakomeje ukwizera kwanjye.
Nahawe inshingano zo kwita ku muntu ukiri muto ufite umugisha mu rusengero.
Uko nagendaga nsaza, icyambabaje cyane ni uko nta mwana nari mfite, kuko umugore wanjye yari ingumba kandi twembi twari tugeze mu zabukuru.
Nasabye Imana yanjye ko yampa undi uzasimbura uwo mu muryango wanjye, umuntu uzakomeza umurage w’ubuhanuzi.
Ubwo nari mpagaze mu cyumba cyo gusenga, abamarayika barampamagaye, bambwira bati 'Allah aguhaye inkuru nziza', maze ntangazwa n'ubwoba n'agahinda.
Bambwiye ko nzabyara umuhungu witwa Yahya, izina ritigeze rihabwa umuntu uwo ari we wese mbere, kandi nk'ikimenyetso ntazavugana n'abantu iminsi itatu.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
